name: Snipe-IT
description: Snipe-IT is an open-source IT asset management system for tracking hardware, software licenses, and more. Self-host it on your own server with Dokploy, which deploys Snipe-IT as a Docker Compose service in a few clicks.
seoDescription: IT asset management and tracking system. Deploy Snipe-IT with Docker Compose on Dokploy in minutes – free, open source, self-hosted.
